text:
omar: Heads up — I'm about to push a least-privilege RBAC tweak for the deploy service account at 10:30 PT. This is aimed at preventing accidental writes to the gpu-pool namespace (we saw a rogue job last week).

lena: Thanks for the ping. Which permissions are you removing?

omar: Removing broad `apps/*` and `rbac.authorization.k8s.io/*` cluster roles from the deploy SA and replacing with a scoped rolebinding limited to our `deployments` k8s resources in `infra-team` namespaces.

mike: Will that break canary jobs that create CronJobs in gpu-pool? We still have a few infra CI flows that do that.

omar: Good call. The plan keeps `batch/v1` create for cronjobs but only in namespace pattern `infra-*`. gpu-pool is `gpu-pool-prod` so should be blocked.

sara: Any KMS impacts? I remember the deploy SA used to have decrypt on the infra KMS key for container image creds.

omar: I'll keep the KMS decrypt permission intact on the infra key. The change only touches k8s RBAC. But audit logs showed failed KMS decrypts from `gpu-ops` last week — separate follow-up required.

kevin: Can we add a quick preflight check so we catch regressions? Maybe run a dry-run against a staging cluster and a log query for `Subject: deploy-sa` + `verb: create` + `resource: cronjobs` before/after.

lena: I can run the dry-run. Suggested command: 
```bash
kubectl auth can-i create cronjobs.batch --as=system:serviceaccount:infra-team:deploy-sa -n gpu-pool-prod 
```
If that returns `no` we're good.

omar: Perfect. Also adding an audit query to confirm no denied events pop up after rollout: 
```bash
# GKE / Stackdriver example
gcloud logging read 'resource.type=k8s_cluster AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:deploy-sa AND protoPayload.request.methodName:CreateCronJob' --limit 50
```
But adjust for our logging setup.

sara: If KMS decrypt failures correlate with blocked access to secrets, we should check KMS key IAM: `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` for the SA. Not touched in this rollout but worth validating.

mike: One more thing — deploy-bot will try to redeploy after the change. Can we add an automatic fallback policy that re-adds the previous clusterrolebinding for 10 minutes if rollout causes >=3 failing deploys?

omar: I don't want to do automated re-grant of perms. Instead I'll add an explicit rollback playbook and a one-click runbook button in Console (ops runbook). Quick mitigation steps: 
- Run `kubectl create clusterrolebinding` to reattach the old role (manual)
- Trigger a redeploy of the failing service
- Notify eng-sre and include audit log slices

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline started for `infra/2026-03-20/rbac-tweak` (build 842).

lena: Dry-run result in staging: `kubectl auth can-i` returned `no` for gpu-pool-prod cronjobs. Staging apps unaffected. I'll run a couple of smoke deploys.

omar: Rolling at 10:30 PT. Will post the exact commit SHA and the list of bindings I change. If anyone sees unexpected denials, ping me and add the audit log snippet.

sara: I'll follow the KMS thread in parallel and post findings if decrypt denies correlate.

mike: I'll monitor alerts and be ready to escalate. :thumbsup:

omar: Thanks all — keeping this tight.
